use_case_summary: Primary: in-app support chat (real-time) with fallback to embeddings-based product search and summarization of long product descriptions. Volume expected: 100-500 end-user chats/day initially. Need low cost per chat while keeping answer quality high for product specs and sizing recommendations.
requirements_summary: Latency SLO: perceived latency <500ms for first token, steady-state token latency ideally <200ms. Throughput modest (burst to 50 rps). Cost sensitive: target <$0.03 per chat (avg). Model concerns: hallucination handling, ability to pin model version for consistency, simple streaming + function call support. Prefer public cloud hosted option for fast time-to-value.
